hero.tagline: Open source · runs on your machine
hero.subtitle:
Agents on your machine run projects, clients and processes
from a single WhatsApp message. You approve first.
hero.windowsNoteTitle: On Windows, the installer isn't signed yet
hero.windowsNoteBody: Your browser will call the download suspicious and Windows will repeat the warning when you open it — not because it found anything, but because we don't yet have a certificate saying whose file this is.
hero.windowsNoteSteps: To continue: on the download warning choose Keep; when running it, click More info and then Run anyway.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Send instructions to the agents that manage your projects straight from your groups, and run processes without ever leaving the company chat.

cards.title: Send it to the group
cards.body: One-off requests are delegated to an agent and flagged for a fast fix — from WhatsApp.
cards.bubble: @codm the invoice for client Acme didn't generate, can you fix it?

cards.title: The agent gets to work
cards.body: A terminal session opens on your project folder, with the skills already in your codebase.

cards.title: The reply lands back in the group
cards.body: Carrying the task's label — whoever asked follows along without leaving the conversation.
cards.bubble: Invoice regenerated and sent. The fix's PR is up for review.

chips.text: whisper — only the agent reads it

cards.title: Skills you already have
cards.body: Invoke /deploy, /triage, /report — any skill in your project folder or codebase, nothing to rewrite.

cards.title: Private guidance
cards.body: Talk to the agent alone mid-conversation. The contact never sees it — only the result.

cards.title: Scheduled processes
cards.body: Prompts that repeat on their own: on a fixed time, on the days you choose, or every N minutes.

cards.title: You approve first
cards.body: Agents pause on errors and sensitive decisions. Nothing goes out without your word.

cards.title: Runs 100% on your computer
cards.body: Your code, your credentials and your conversations never leave your machine.

cards.title: Several agents per conversation
cards.body: Claude Code today, Codex and OpenCode coming soon — each task with the right agent.

cases.title: Bug triage
cases.body: The client reports it in the group, the message becomes a classified task, and the agent already opens the terminal on the right folder.

cases.title: Customer support
cases.body: Automated conversations with human approval: the agent drafts, you review, the channel receives it.

cases.title: Internal processes
cases.body: Deploy, report, billing — any script becomes a sentence in the company group.

cases.title: On-call without a queue
cases.body: Ten requests in the same thread don't queue up: each one runs in parallel on your machine.

pricing.explanation: Everything that runs on your machine is free — the agents are yours and the code is MIT. The account is free and only identifies you: no card.
included: Unlimited use — no cap on tasks or messages
Claude Code today · Codex and OpenCode coming soon
